purpose: Teach: 賑わい/背骨/減価/声高/子女/食い違い/異に/突っ込ま

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 商店街の、本気で、絶対、賑わい、絶対、当社、絶対、貢献しろ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: I need this company to actively contribute to the vitality of the shopping district. That's non-negotiable.
lines.style: Firm, measured opening. Weight on each directive. Steady eye contact. The tone of someone accustomed to being heard without raising his voice.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。当社の事業の、本気で、絶対、背骨、絶対、製造業、絶対、強化しております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Understood. We've been strengthening manufacturing as the core backbone of our business operations. Thank you for the clear direction.
lines.style: Respectful but not deferential. Calm, methodical pacing. Slight nod of affirmation. Professional acknowledgment without self-effacement.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 設備の、本気で、絶対、減価、絶対、償却、絶対、計画、絶対、見直せ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: I want you to review our equipment depreciation schedule. Revisit those projections.
lines.style: Direct instruction, not request. Crisp consonants on "review." Brief, economical phrasing. Expects compliance without elaboration.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。当社、本気で、絶対、声高、絶対、な広告、絶対、避けて、絶対、進めております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. We're being deliberately careful about our advertising approach—avoiding any sensationalism. We're committed to that restraint.
lines.style: Precise, deliberate word choice. Slight emphasis on "carefully." Even delivery, professional reassurance without over-explaining.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 社員の、本気で、絶対、子女、絶対、教育支援、絶対、当社、絶対、進めろ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: Make sure the company moves forward on education support for employees' children. That's a priority.
lines.style: Directive with underlying concern. Slower pace than before—this one matters beyond the quarterly reports. Weight on "priority."

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。部署間の、本気で、絶対、食い違い、絶対、解消、絶対、進めております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. We're actively resolving the inconsistencies between departments. We're keeping that work in motion.
lines.style: Steady confidence. Slight tempo increase showing momentum. Clean phrasing. The tone of someone solving problems quietly and methodically.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 競合と、本気で、絶対、戦略を、絶対、異に、絶対、する、絶対、決断、絶対、必要だ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: We need to make a decisive choice about how we differentiate our strategy from competitors. That decision can't wait.
lines.style: Heavier emphasis. Slower than usual. Weight on "decisive." The gravity of forward momentum. Less bureaucratic, more strategic.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。新市場に、本気で、絶対、突っ込ま、絶対、ない、絶対、慎重路線、絶対、当社、絶対、堅持しております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Understood. We're maintaining a cautious approach to new markets—not rushing in rashly. That's our current course, and we're holding it.
lines.style: Final affirmation. Calm, concluding tone. Slight settling-in quality, like the end of a report. Composed, assured, complete.
